title: 185. Guess Number Higher or Lower

examples.explanation: The hidden number is 6; binary search with the guess API finds 6.
With only one possible number, the answer is 1.
Guessing 1 hits immediately; otherwise the API directs the search to 1.

hints: Simulate the guess API locally: compare mid with pick to get -1, 1, or 0.
Binary-search the inclusive interval [1, n]; move to [mid+1, right] when the guess is low and [left, mid-1] when it is high.
Compute mid as left + (right - left) / 2 to avoid overflow.
